meta.source: Real data: EIA weekly gasoline (via FRED GASREGW) + FRED WTI (DCOILWTICO)
warnings: Crude data ends 2026-11-03, but gas prices run through 2026-11-09. The newest week's crude value averages only 1 trading day(s), so the upcoming forecast leans on a stale crude reading. Re-download DCOILWTICO.csv once FRED adds newer days.

Only 262 weeks of overlapping data (starting 2021-11-08). FRED's default download covers just the last 5 years: on the DCOILWTICO page set the date range to the maximum and re-download for far more training weeks, which should help every model.
